answer: Per-identity work each epoch: every account must answer a fresh, unique writing challenge graded by a randomly drawn jury. Like a falcon that must keep flapping to stay aloft, a fake identity earns nothing unless it does new work every round, so a plume of 1,000 Sybils costs the attacker 1,000x the model calls and effort. Juries also flag near-duplicate answers, which act as a beacon of collusion and get the cluster slashed.
